title: Happy Anniversary Charlie Brown CD GRP Jazz Peanuts Dave Brubeck Kenny G
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Happy Anniversary, Charlie Brown! (GRP Records GRD-9596, 1989).
GRP Digital Master. Produced by Michael Abene; executive producers
Dave Grusin and Larry Rosen, in cooperation with Lee Mendelson
Productions and United Media.

A jazz tribute to the Peanuts music of Vince Guaraldi, featuring
Patti Austin, David Benoit, Dave Brubeck, Chick Corea, Kenny G,
Dave Grusin, B.B. King, Gerry Mulligan, Amani A.W.-Murray,
Lee Ritenour and Joe Williams.

1. Linus & Lucy - David Benoit (4:10)
2. Joe Cool - B.B. King (3:49)
3. History Lesson - Dave Grusin (4:52)
4. The Great Pumpkin Waltz - Chick Corea (3:38)
5. Little Birdie - Joe Williams (3:38)
6. Rain, Rain, Go Away - Gerry Mulligan (4:29)
7. Breadline Blues - Kenny G (4:10)
8. Red Baron (3:24)
9. Christmas Time Is Here - Patti Austin (3:24)
10. Charlie Brown Theme - Amani A.W.-Murray (3:48)
11. Benjamin - Dave Brubeck (3:02)
12. Linus & Lucy (Reprise with the Peanuts Gang)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
